multi_entity_note: Two parties, CRO Consulting (Pty) Limited and Purinix Pharmaceuticals LLC, with separate addresses.
processing_note: Fur the purposes of invoicing, invoices shall be addressed to: Purinix Pharmaceuticals LLC [***] Att: Chief Executive Officer

contract.document_name.rationale: The title and preamble name it the Master Service Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The preamble states it was entered into on May 25th, 2018; the signature dates read 25/05/2008, an inconsistent (apparently mistyped) year.

contract.effective_date.value: the date of signature of the Agreement by both parties
contract.effective_date.rationale: Clause 3.1 says the Agreement takes effect on the date of signature by both parties.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement ends when obligations are performed; no expiration date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Clause 12.7 selects the laws of the State of Connecticut, U.S.A.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No automatic renewal term is provided.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The 30-day notices concern termination for breach or without cause, not preventing renewal.
